note: The maintainer asked for this release to carry the update fix, the top-bar fix and the Arc-styled controls, knowing the packaged-window, clean-install, upgrade and live-provider journeys below were not walked on this build. Missing journeys are recorded as not_observed; release_readiness.py is expected to refuse complete stable-readiness certification.

fresh_install.evidence: Installer not run: this machine has Kriko installed and the installer's hook would stop it and rewrite its registration. The installer was extracted with 7-Zip instead: it holds the app, the engine and OpenSERP and no catalogs.

portable_start.evidence: Portable archive built and hashed; the extracted portable window was not walked.

setup.evidence: Not walked on the packaged window.

compare.evidence: Compare and Queue were seen in the web interface's demo mode in Chrome; packaged Compare was not walked live.

reconnect.evidence: Not walked on the packaged window.

upgrade_retains_data.evidence: No installed-version upgrade was performed, so the 0.3.2-to-0.3.4 path through the installer was not walked. engineupdate.offer was checked for a 0.3.2 shell against the 0.3.3 manifest edit and returned the installer.

sourced_answer.evidence: No live research was run against the 0.3.4 frozen engine; nothing in this release changes research.

follow_up.evidence: Not walked; nothing in this release changes follow-up routing.

observed_instead: Gate stages ui, node and py passed on the Arc branch before merge: 4,561 Python tests passed, 23 skipped; extension 514; UI 92.
Frozen 0.3.4 engine, extracted from the installer, started in 2.1 seconds on a throwaway profile and answered /api/health with version 0.3.4, extension 0.4.6 and no catalogs.

In the web interface's demo mode (dev server) in Chrome: the settings gear, the Arc textarea, file picker, checkboxes and fold-aways in the drawer panels, and Compare and Queue. The extension settings page was served from a static server: its checkbox and radio were seen drawn in the new style.
The Windows package script finished with exit code 0; its log was not read.
Installer, portable and engine ZIP SHA-256 sums recorded in SHA256SUMS.txt.
